Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: Construct a complete truth table for the following argument. Then, using the truth table, determine whether the argument is valid or invalid. If the argument is invalid, choose an option which presents a counterexample. (There may be other counterexamples as well.)
~(M ≡ ~N)
M / N

Options: 
A. Invalid. Counterexample when M is false and N is false
B. Invalid. Counterexample when M and N are true
C. Invalid. Counterexample when N is false and M is true
D. Invalid. Counterexample when N is true and M is false
E. Valid
F. Invalid. Counterexample when M is false and N is true
G. Invalid. Counterexample when both M and N are false
H. Invalid. Counterexample when M and N alternate in truth value
I. Invalid. Counterexample when M is true and N is false

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
